So Nestlé is slate-tethered to New York City and cannot fail to be: no. Without the edit nothing ties Nestlé to New York City, so the answer would be yes.

notes: Fictional relation insert (RBox) with a role chain through real knowledge (README, RBox items: Role chains through real knowledge). It composes the made-up slate_tethered_to with the real headquartered_in. Each derived query states only the made-up link between real firms; the real hop (the bank's headquarters city) is left to the model and checked before editing. Banks chosen for single, undisputed headquarters (not UBS, Zurich/Basel). The second query is phrased so it is no only after the edit (without it, Nestlé could well fail to be slate-tethered to New York City). Replaces the earlier 0017 (lodestar_lender_to inverse), which used two made-up relations and repeated the pure-prompt pattern of 0015 and 0016. Written by hand, not a builder script.
